notes: S2/F61-3 (§9.2 rule 2, §14.5): body.new_key is a number. new_key and old_key are key ids of the body table; their grammar is part of the structural body check that runs before signature verification (T13) and precedes the key-material rule, which compares a public key with a well-formed key id: E_KIND_BODY_SCHEMA, not E_KEY_ROTATION_KEYS or a key-resolution outcome; no signature check runs (sigs []).
